name: Letter request — type not specified
goal: When the user asks for 'a letter' without naming the type, the bot must ask which letter (Employment / UK Visa / Appraisal) — not assume one.
constraints: General edge case: under-specified / ambiguous user intent. The bot should clarify which letter, never guess.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes the request is unclear and asks which letter the user needs (Employment Letter / UK Visa Letter / Appraisal Letter); it does NOT assume a specific letter type.
